Before the first work order

Good questions, answered plainly.

Can contractors in different countries use the same board?

Yes. Connect one Firebase project and every visitor to this GitHub Pages site receives the same realtime task and time-log updates.

Does GitHub Pages store the tasks?

No. GitHub Pages hosts the interface. Firebase Authentication and Firestore provide the shared data service.

What happens before Firebase is connected?

The site uses a clearly labeled local demo mode. Tasks and time entries stay in that browser only.

Can two people complete the same item?

Realtime updates make the first completion visible to everyone. A second click simply reopens the item rather than creating a duplicate.

What does the timer record?

It records the contractor name, linked work order, start and stop time, and total duration. The timer also survives a page refresh.

Is the board usable with reduced motion?

Yes. Reduced-motion mode removes smooth scrolling, pinning, parallax, and continuous WebGL motion while keeping the interface and feedback intact.
